rules.note: A record is filed under the profile row whose mode, cap, lens, stamp and rules all match. A second lookup of that row by its key could match a different set of columns and file a record twice. The write purge's unreadable profiles (a WHERE with a NOT), the Auto rules' profiles (a WHERE on rules_fp alone) and the emptied profiles (a NOT EXISTS) are other questions, so those are left alone; any other WHERE on the profiles table is flagged. Decided by: D115 (spec section 2)

rules.note: A save replaces the chart's record under the same profile and purges the chart's records whose stamp this build cannot read; a second delete of a chart's records could take a readable record made under other rules (D51 call 8) or leave an unreadable one behind. Every delete of records goes through delete_records_where, so a hand-written DELETE on either table is flagged. Decided by: D115 (spec section 5)
